current_episode.title: Mushrooms in Focus: Industry Insights with Tony Stackhurski

guest.bio_context: Tony brings over 20 years of experience in family-run agricultural business, previously leading operations at Hardee's and Texas Harvest, a large processing company. He joined Kitchen Pride in 2023 and has since overseen 30-50 million pounds of agaricus mushroom production annually, transitioning from zero commercial growing experience to managing large-scale indoor mushroom farm operations in Texas.

context.real_quote: Mushroom farming is unlike any other crop. I mean, there isn't a parallel. It is an indoor crop, but it's very different.

pending_qa.q: What role does retailer engagement play in the sustainability of mushroom farming operations?
pending_qa.r: Retailers have tremendous sales force capability with mushrooms, which can move significant volume. The category needs retailers to visit mushroom farmers, buy local, buy USA, and recognize that pricing pressures and raw material increases are landscape-wide issues affecting all farms. Long-term success of the mushroom category requires collaborative partnership between growers, packers, and retail buyers.
